title: The Labour Day Hammock Accord
skyStory: A first quarter moon gallops into Sagittarius with a backpack and a map it has not read. Half lit, half shadow, it is the moon equivalent of a long weekend: half rest, half packing for tomorrow. Jupiter, ruler of Sagittarius, has declared a holiday for all the planets. Mars is pretending to rest while quietly reorganizing the asteroid belt.

reading: It is a day off, and your whole being is going to try to turn it into a day on. A small project will call to you, a shelf, a script, a garden bed. The [[Four of Swords]] lies down across the doorway like a very calm dog. You will have to step over it on purpose.

Rest is not a reward you earn after finishing everything. That is the whole lesson of [[The Sun]] reversed in your spread: joy is allowed before the to-do list is clean. So go outside. Throw something, a ball, a stick, a frisbee. The Fire Tiger is built for play as much as for work, and Sagittarius is the most playful moon of the month.
joel.mission: Spend one full hour today doing something with no purpose whatsoever, and if anyone asks, say it is research.
joel.omen: A dog sprawled in the sun, legs everywhere. That is the correct posture for today; copy it.

reading: Sagittarius moons make you want to go somewhere, even a short somewhere. The road along the water. The trail with the good view. A drive just to see what the trees are up to. The early maples on the hilltops are already flirting with red.

If the day lets you, take the long way home. Somewhere on it you will notice a sign, an actual painted road sign, with a word on it that answers a question you have been chewing on. The Mountain does not need to rush to the top. It only needs to enjoy the view on the way, and today the view is very good.
nancy.mission: Take a route you never take, even for one block, and name the most surprising thing you saw.
nancy.omen: A hand painted roadside sign. A small decision is easier than you are making it.

together.text: Declare a joint holiday from being useful. For the rest of the day, neither of you can mention a chore without paying a fine of one compliment to the other. Jupiter will keep the tab. Jupiter is extremely generous with credit.
